newsitem.title: USA: U.S. spot propane steady to weaker in late trade.
newsitem.headline: U.S. spot propane steady to weaker in late trade.

text.p: U.S. spot propane prices were steady to weaker in quiet late trade on Thursday finding some support in NYMEX futures and talk Amoco Corp may have a catalytic cracker down, players said.
In the U.S. Gulf Coast, Mont Belvieu, Texas, spot propane traded at 50.50 cents a gallon, largely unchanged since midday. Buyers were about a half cent lower at 50.00 cents gallon.
In Conway, Kansas, hub spot material fell 0.75 cent to 51.25/51.75 cents after a day of volatile, but quiet trade, players said.

The market briefly found some support in talk that Amoco Corp's 120,000 barrel per day gasoline making unit at its Texas City, Texas, refinery was down. Amoco, however, would not confirm or deny the rumors.
-- Laney Salisbury, New York Energy Desk +1 212 859 1631
